name: Rogowski TI Gerber Coil Generator
description: Two independent windings recreated from TI TIDA010971E2.0 copper and NC drill geometry.
description_full: KiCad 10 dual-winding PCB Rogowski coil using TI reference Top/Bottom trace templates. The 32-position mode has 66 vias; variable counts (12 to 96 multiples of 4, excluding 32) have 2N+2 vias. The lower breakout via and tip follow the adjacent winding connection height, with a vertical via leg and horizontal coil connection. Upper breakout anchors and layer connectivity are preserved. Small half-circle and quarter-circle bends use one configurable common radius (default 0.385 mm), with exact 180/90 degree sweeps and shared connection endpoints adjusted together; infeasible radii are rejected. Reference breakout angular space is retained. Successful dimension and copper-overlap validation is required before generation. Live preview and parameter highlighting are supported. See README for limitations.
